image_description: A low-angle shot of a large pipe organ situated within an ornate, organic-style architectural interior (resembling Gaudí's Sagrada Família). The organ features multiple clusters of vertical metallic pipes of varying heights, arranged symmetrically around a central taller cluster. The pipes have a reflective blue-grey metallic finish. Below the pipes is a dark, shadowed console area with visible keyboards and stop mechanisms. The background shows branching stone columns and stained glass windows.
